issue_title: Deck builder copy-limit affordance: alias spellings counted separately, search-add ungated
subsystem: deckbuilder (React client, no game-state pair per playbook step 2)
ceiling_grounding: Nazgûl oracle text in pinned card-data.json (v0.78.0): 'A deck can have up to nine cards named Nazgûl.'; canonical card-data key is lowercase 'nazgûl'.
Issue triage: per-name ceilings are unaffected by the bug — maxDeckCopies(name, format) canonicalizes engine-side via canonical_deck_count_key.
Lightning Bolt: no printed override; the format default (4) applies.

The WASM engine cannot be built on this host (no Rust toolchain; client-only sparse checkout), so maxDeckCopies is mocked to return exactly the engine-resolved values above. Ceiling resolution is explicitly not the component under test.
